mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, -99999) AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'H' AND RAIN_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY RAIN_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(RAIN, -99999) AS RAIN, AREA_CODE, DATA_TYPE FROM RAIN_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND RAIN_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(AVR_VAL, -99999) AS TEMP FROM TEMP_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND TEMP_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY TEMP_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(MAX_VAL, -99999) AS TEMP_MAX, IFNULL(MIN_VAL, -99999) AS TEMP_MIN FROM TEMP_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND TEMP_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT IFNULL(AVR_VEL1, -99999) AS WIND_VEL, IFNULL(AVR_DEG1, -99999) AS WIND_DEG FROM WIND_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND WIND_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY WIND_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(AVR_VAL, -99999) AS HUMI FROM HUMI_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND HUMI_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY HUMI_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(MAX_VAL, -99999) AS HUMI_MAX, IFNULL(MIN_VAL, -99999) AS HUMI_MIN FROM HUMI_HIST WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'D' AND HUMI_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND AREA_CODE = #{area_code}

SELECT r.AREA_CODE, rh.RAIN as RAIN_H, rd.RAIN as RAIN_D, tm.AVR_VAL as TEMP, td.MAX_VAL as TEMP_MAX, td.MIN_VAL as TEMP_MIN, wm.AVR_VEL1 as WIND_VEL, wm.AVR_DEG1 as AVR_DEG, wd.MAX_VEL as WIND_MAX_VEL, wd.MAX_DEG as MAX_DEG, hm.AVR_VAL as HUMI, hd.MAX_VAL as HUMI_MAX, hd.MIN_VAL as HUMI_MIN FROM rtu_info r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AREA_CODE, RAIN FROM rain_hist WHERE RAIN_DATE BETWEEN date_add(NOW(), interval -2 hour) AND now() AND DATA_TYPE = 'H' ORDER BY RAIN_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) rh ON r.AREA_CODE = rh.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AREA_CODE, RAIN FROM rain_hist WHERE RAIN_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND DATA_TYPE = 'D' ORDER BY RAIN_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) rd ON r.AREA_CODE = rd.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AREA_CODE, AVR_VAL FROM temp_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND TEMP_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -2 hour) AND now() ORDER BY TEMP_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) tm ON r.AREA_CODE = tm.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AREA_CODE, MAX_VAL, MIN_VAL FROM temp_hist WHERE TEMP_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND DATA_TYPE = 'D' ORDER BY TEMP_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) td ON r.AREA_CODE = td.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AREA_CODE, AVR_VEL1, AVR_DEG1 FROM wind_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND WIND_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -2 hour) AND now() ORDER BY WIND_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) wm ON r.AREA_CODE = wm.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AREA_CODE, MAX_VEL, MAX_DEG FROM wind_hist WHERE WIND_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND DATA_TYPE = 'D' ORDER BY WIND_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) wd ON r.AREA_CODE = wd.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AREA_CODE, AVR_VAL FROM humi_hist WHERE DATA_TYPE = 'M' AND HUMI_DATE BETWEEN date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) AND now() ORDER BY HUMI_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) hm ON r.AREA_CODE = hm.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AREA_CODE, MAX_VAL, MIN_VAL FROM humi_hist WHERE HUMI_DATE = CAST(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND DATA_TYPE = 'D' ORDER BY HUMI_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) hd ON r.AREA_CODE = hd.AREA_CODE WHERE r.AREA_CODE IN
#{areaCode}
